role: Hostile mob probe: zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders and the other hostile kinds in HostileProbe.KINDS (enderman, witch, silverfish, pig zombie, blaze, ...) ticking with a probe player (HostileProbe.ProbePlayer) in a flattened raw-region arena (roofed room, doors, pool, wall), day or night; records per-tick FNV-1a hashes of canonical NBT plus AI, path, helper, attack and per-kind state, spawns, removals, events and explosions, as the reference for EntityMob, targeting, hostile AI tasks, arrows and explosions.
notes: Output DIR/manifest.json (kind hostiles), shapes.bin, spawns.bin, ticks.bin.gz, digest/nbt64/spawns/removals/events .txt.gz, start.txt, end.txt, final.bin.gz. Dispatched through Oracle's reflective {"cmd":"run","class":...}.
